name: tooltip
purpose: Surfaces a short hint anchored to a trigger element when the user hovers, focuses, or long-presses it. Use for icon-only buttons, abbreviations, or any control whose meaning is not obvious from its label alone. **Not** for rich content or interactive children — use `overlay/popover` instead.
useWhen: Naming an icon-only control on hover and focus.
Revealing the full text of a truncated label, or expanding an abbreviation.
One short, plain-text hint that the user can do without.
avoidWhen: The content has links, buttons or more than one line of structure → use `popover`.
An info glyph beside a field label or column header → use `hint`.
A glossed term inside documentation prose → use `doc-tooltip`.
Guidance or errors the user needs to complete a field → use `helper-text`.
related: popover` — click-opened, interactive, with a header, body and footer.
hint` — the focusable info glyph that renders a `Tooltip` for you.
doc-tooltip` — inline glossed term for docs pages.
icon-button` — the most common trigger; it still needs its own `ariaLabel`.
bestPractices: Wrap a focusable element. The tooltip opens on the wrapper's `focusin`, and the wrapper itself is not focusable.
Keep `text` to a few words. It renders as plain text, with no markup.
The tooltip describes its trigger (`aria-describedby`) but does not name it. Icon-only triggers still need their own accessible name.
Use `disabled` to suppress the tooltip. An empty `text` also blocks opening, but it reads as a bug.
Keep the default `delay` (200 ms) unless a dense toolbar needs a longer one.

props.name: text
props.doc: Plain text shown inside the tooltip.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Anchor side relative to the trigger; `auto` picks the side with room.

events.name: update:open
events.notes: v-model:open. Fires on open and close.

events.name: show
events.notes: Emitted right after the open transition starts.

events.name: hide
events.notes: Emitted right after the close transition starts.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The trigger element. Tooltip anchors to its bounding box.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import Tooltip from '@aziontech/webkit/tooltip'
</script>

<template>
  <Tooltip
    text="This is a Tooltip"
    placement="top"
  >
    <Button
      label="Hover me"
      kind="outlined"
      size="medium"
    />
  </Tooltip>
</template>
